Subject: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Hannah,

Quick procurement question as we prepare to issue the PO for Redwood: our finance team requires a vendor setup form before we can create the PO. Can you confirm what vendor fields you need (tax id, remit address, bank account details)?

Also a couple of constraints from our side:
- We typically operate on Net45 payment terms for SaaS vendors; is Redwood able to accept Net45?
- We prefer one consolidated invoice per month covering all usage in the period. If there are multiple PO numbers (we sometimes split POs by cost center), can Redwood accept multiple PO numbers on a single invoice or should each PO map to a separate invoice?
- For commercial discounts, our procurement team prefers discounts shown as line-item discounts rather than post-invoice credits. Is that something you can accommodate?

I've attached our vendor setup form for your team to complete.

Thanks — we want to move quickly on this. Can you loop in whoever handles billing/finance at Redwood so we can align?

Best,
Anna Lewis
Procurement Manager, HealthSync

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Rishi (AE) and Laura (Finance) to confirm operational details. Answers inline below.

> vendor fields you need
We can provide a vendor pack with: legal name, W-9/EIN (or local tax id), remit-to mailing address, bank remit info (ACH/Swift), and our AP contact. I'll attach our standard invoice template to show where PO and remit details appear. (See Redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx)

> Net45
We can accept Net45 for enterprise customers pending standard credit review and a signed MSA. Our default for self-serve is Net30, but Net45 is supported for committed bookings. If HealthSync needs Net45 for the entire term, we'll note that in the amendment.

> consolidated monthly invoices / multiple POs
We can issue a consolidated monthly invoice that lists multiple PO numbers in the invoice header and in the line-item notes, provided your AP can supply a mapping file that links PO -> cost center / charge lines. If you cannot supply mapping, we can accept a single master PO and you can internally map. Either approach works operationally; the mapping reduces accounting reconciliation work on both sides.

> discount as line item vs credit
We typically prefer line-item discounts to make reporting clean, but we can also issue a credit memo if your AP requires that format. Note: eligibility and timing differ — line-item discounts appear on the invoice itself; credit memos can be applied later and may be split across invoices.

Action items:
- I'll send our vendor pack + invoice template (attached).
- Rishi will propose the commercial form of the discount we discussed on the deal.
- Laura, can you confirm whether Redwood can apply a staged onboarding credit (e.g., 5% off first 2 invoices) as a line-item discount or whether finance prefers a single credit memo?

Thanks — we should be able to turn the setup around in 2–3 business days once we get the completed vendor form.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template_v2.xlsx

Proposal (recommended):
- Accept Net45 for the first 12 months (subject to signed amendment).
- Issue one consolidated monthly invoice that can list multiple PO numbers (HealthSync to supply mapping file); if they can't provide mapping, accept a single master PO.
- Apply the 5% onboarding credit as a line-item discount on the first invoice if procurement insists; alternatively, issue a credit memo to be applied across the first two invoices. Finance preference?
- We will populate PO number(s) in both the invoice header and the line-item level (ERP-friendly).
- Need finance to pre-approve a one-time credit of up to $15k to be delivered as described.

Laura — any constraints around our AP systems (Net45 timing, credit memos vs line-item discounts, posting to ERP) we should flag to the customer? Also confirm the remit-to address to place on the vendor form.

Thanks,
Hannah

Thanks for the summary. A few operational notes from Finance: 
- Net45 is fine for this account provided we have a signed MSA and a billing contact (for collections escalation).
- We can display discounts as invoice line items. That is preferable because it maps cleanly into our revenue recognition and reporting.
- We can also issue a credit memo; if the customer prefers one-time upfront credit, we can generate a negative invoice/credit and apply it immediately. That requires AP to accept credit memos in their ERP — HealthSync will need to confirm.
- Multiple PO numbers on one invoice: our billing system can accept a PO list in the invoice header and also include PO refs on charge lines. If HealthSync will supply a CSV mapping (PO -> charge code), we can auto-ingest and include those references on the invoice.

Operational ask for the customer: please provide the completed vendor setup form + confirm whether your ERP accepts credit memos (and if you prefer a single upfront credit or staged application).

We can approve a one-time onboarding credit up to $15,000 — finance will record it as a contra-revenue item and either show it as a line-item discount or a credit memo per the customer's preference.

I'll attach the SLA exception form if they request billing cadence deviating from standard.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — thanks for the vendor form. Below is the practical approach Redwood can take to keep your accounting simple and get the PO issued quickly: 

1) Vendor setup: attached is our vendor pack + invoice template. Please fill any missing fields on your vendor form and return to this thread.

2) Payment terms: Redwood will accept Net45 for HealthSync provided the MSA is signed. We'll include Net45 in the amendment to the MSA.

3) Invoice cadence / PO mapping: Redwood will send one consolidated invoice per calendar month. We can include multiple PO numbers on a single invoice. Preferred workflow: HealthSync provides a CSV that maps PO -> cost center/charge lines; we will ingest and populate PO refs on the invoice lines. If you cannot provide mapping, we can accept a single master PO.

4) Discount treatment (onboarding credit): Redwood will offer a 5% onboarding credit up to $15,000. Options:
   a) Show 5% as a line-item discount on the first invoice (preferred for reporting), or
   b) Issue a single credit memo to be applied to the first invoice upon AP acceptance of credit memos.

Please confirm which option HealthSync prefers. If option (a) is fine we will prepare the invoice template accordingly and no extra AP steps will be required on your side.

5) PO placement & remit: we'll include the PO number in the invoice header and in each relevant charge line for ERP traceability. Our remit address is listed in the vendor pack.

Next steps: once you return the completed vendor form and confirm discount preference (line-item vs credit memo), Rishi will create an amendment for Net45 and we can proceed to PO issuance. I've also linked our HubSpot record and a DocuSign amendment for convenience.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.
